server_name.description: Public name of the FTP server displayed to clients.

port.description: Port number on which the FTP daemon listens.

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to (leave empty to bind to all interfaces).

daemon_user.description: User account under which the ProFTPD daemon runs.

daemon_group.description: Group account under which the ProFTPD daemon runs.

umask.description: Umask for newly created files (e.g., '022' for 0644/0755).

sqlite_path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite3 database file containing user/group info.

log_file.description: Path to detailed access log file (e.g., '/var/log/proftpd/access.log'). Leave empty to use syslog.

log_dir.description: Directory for ProFTPD logs (used if log_file is set).

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for secure connections (FTPES). Requires certificate/key.

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate for client verification (optional).

require_valid_shell.description: Require users have a valid shell in the database (set to false for virtual-only users).

max_conn_per_ip.description: Maximum concurrent connections allowed per user.

passive_ports_start.description: Start of passive port range (e.g., 50000). Required for firewall/NAT compatibility.

timeout_idle.description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting inactive clients.

timeout_nolisten.description: No-transfer timeout in seconds (data connection not established).

allow_users.description: List of usernames allowed to log in (if empty, no explicit allow rule applied).

allow_groups.description: List of groups whose members may log in (if empty, no explicit allow rule applied).

access_rules.description: List of custom access control rules per user/group.

group.description: Target group name for rule (conflicts with `user`).

allow_operations.description: FTP commands allowed for this user/group.

deny_operations.description: FTP commands denied for this user/group.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the rule.

include_dir.description: Directory containing additional .conf files to include (common for modules or vhosts).
